obligations.source_text: The complete outfit topology, neckline, both shoulders and sleeves, waist and closure or crotch and inseam region, legs, and hems must remain fully visible and readable in one vertical full-body frame.

bindings.front_panels_phrase: two separate front-panel edges remain traceable from the wrap V neckline to the side fastening
bindings.overlap_depth_phrase: one panel visibly continues beneath the other, and coherent fold depth proves a real diagonal overlap
bindings.wrap_neckline_phrase: the crossing edges form a coherent wrap V neckline, sharing one continuous edge path with the diagonal overlap
bindings.side_fastening_phrase: a side tie button or fixed seam holds the overlap, connecting both wrap panels under visible functional tension
bindings.false_wrap_confound_phrase: a printed diagonal line does not substitute for panel overlap, and a decorative waist tie or loose scarf cannot carry the closure
